title: picking manager widgets
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkPickingManager with balloon, box, and implicit plane widgets.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → selection → interaction → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkAppendPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAppendPolyData.html) — append poly data.
- [vtkBalloonRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBalloonRepresentation.html) — balloon representation.
- [vtkBalloonWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBalloonWidget.html) — balloon widget.
- [vtkBoxWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBoxWidget.html) — box widget.
- [vtkClipPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkClipPolyData.html) — clips polygonal data with an implicit function.
- [vtkConeSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkConeSource.html) — generates a polygonal cone.
- [vtkCylinderSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCylinderSource.html) — generates a polygonal cylinder.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkImplicitPlaneRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImplicitPlaneRepresentation.html) — implicit plane representation.
- [vtkImplicitPlaneWidget2](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImplicitPlaneWidget2.html) — implicit plane widget2.
- [vtkInteractorStyleTrackballCamera](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractorStyleTrackballCamera.html) — interactor style trackball camera.
- [vtkPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlane.html) — defines an implicit plane function.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPropPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPropPicker.html) — prop picker.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
